name: Ratnabhumi Developers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2007, Ratnabhumi Developers Ltd is in the business of construction of buildings and other construction related services and renting services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RDL is a real estate development company and a part of the Ahmedabad-based Ratna group. All the projects of RDL are in the vicinity of Ahmedabad. The company has executed a total of 22 residential
 and commercial projects to date and is currently executing three mixed- development projects under the brand Turquoise.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 73.8% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 7.20 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.79% over last 3 years.
